text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) can cause serious risks like birth defects and liver problems, alongside common side effects such as stuffy nose, headache, and swelling.

list.snippet: Serious birth defects: Opsumit causes major birth defects if taken during pregnancy. Patients must avoid pregnancy and use strict birth control.
Liver problems: It can elevate liver enzymes and cause liver injury. Blood tests are required before and during treatment.
Fluid retention: Swelling in the hands, legs, ankles, or feet can happen, sometimes requiring medical care.
Anemia: Low red blood cell levels may cause unusual tiredness or pale skin.
Decreased sperm counts: The medication can affect male fertility.
Stuffy or runny nose and sore throat

text_blocks.snippet: You can read more safety details on the Opsumit Important Safety Information page.
If you are taking or considering Opsumit, let me know if you would like information on required monitoring tests or pregnancy prevention programs.
